title: Self-Tor projection and representative-comparison homology step
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pc-self-tor-pushforward-homology, for any complex Q on Z equipped with an isomorphism from Q to the termwise tensor pullback T of P, the degree-k homology of the derived tensor square of the pushed-forward structure sheaf is isomorphic to the pushforward of the degree-k homology of Q.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.22.1, together with Tags 068G and 08KS

proof.text: Apply the qcqs derived projection formula to the closed immersion, identify the derived pullback of the pushed-forward structure sheaf with the chosen K-flat representative, and use exactness of closed-immersion pushforward to commute homology with pushforward. Transport along the supplied complex isomorphism Q ≅ T.

based_on.place: projection formula and K-flat representative comparison
